disclosure: This model separates audited or source-supported historical figures, management-certified group figures, interim management inputs and forward projections. Projections are not statutory, audited or guaranteed results.

periods.interimStatement: Management input states that revenue, profit, assets and related headline values at 30 June 2026 are approximately 2% below the corresponding full-year 2025 totals.

baseline.note: Exact group profit and asset values remain input-required in this model; no number is invented.

interimManagementInput.calculation: known baseline values x 0.98; unknown values remain null

flowMetrics.description: Revenue and profit are treated as flow metrics. H2 is modelled as a percentage of H1.

stockMetrics.description: Assets, capital and liabilities are point-in-time balances and are not annualised. Year-end values require balance-sheet assumptions or a later actual source.

budgetGovernance.planningCapacitySource: approved scenario and current management input
budgetGovernance.departmentBudgets: relative allocation envelopes until an approved expense ceiling is entered
